sections.voiceover: Messerschmitt designed the Me 262 as the world's first operational jet-powered fighter aircraft. German aircraft manufacturer Arado built the Arado Ar 234 Blitz as the world's first operational turbojet-powered bomber. Author Sterling Michael Pavelec documented the German jet program from 1939 to 1945.
